exact_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: existing painted game diffuse texture. Faithful subtle HD paint refinement, preserving source appearance/material and every UV position; not a photographed or rendered replacement object.

Input: sole opaque storedRGB reference is the ENTIRE original source nearest-enlarged to maximum dimension512. Output the complete same-aspect canvas with all original framing, count, scale, relative light and dark, no border/crop/padding/zoom/reposition.

Native64x64, guide512x512. Keep complete original dark gray/bluegreen painted metal atlas and reddish-brown checked-grip field. Preserve every source shape, dark recess, faint round field, slim bottom pale lines and existing tiny pale point native50,34. The faint checked paint interior native[43,25,56,30] has EXACT measured maxima: rows25/27/29 x44,46,48,50,52,54 (6each), rows26/28 x45,47,49,51,53 (5each):28 measured light maxima, pitch2 native pixels with alternating1pixel phase. These are source paint values, not permission for a new larger diamond knurl/grille. Preserve source checks as faint matte paint, no coarsening, raised cell edges, new ribs or regularization outside that original pattern. Source A0..255 stays original separately in engine; leave all original dark/shadow RGB fields present.

Materials: subdued original matte gray/bluegray/olive/darkbrown painted palette and fine source grain. Add only extremely subtle finer paint within original appearance, keeping original broad shade and soft edges, every weak narrow source mark dark/dim. No new etched/photographic grain, white raised rim/bevel, gold shine/gloss, coarse wood/leather, larger checker cells, new scratches/creases/stitches or invented hardware/part detail. Keep original local paint brightness hierarchy; do not turn source shadow into a new physical feature.

Constraints: every source visible band, patterned field, tiny pale/dark mark, circular paint and gap retains original position/size/count/phase. No additional glyph/text/numbers/logo/fastener/hole/pin/groove/line or geometry. Entire opaque RGB texture only; engine retains/restores full original alpha separately. Do not rearrange UV sections or complete missing parts; preserve original imperfect source paint exactly.

source_transform_recipe.operations: Native stored RGBA→opaqueRGB, wholecanvas NEAREST8x. No crop/padding/rotate/UV fitting/unpremultiply/art inserted. SourceA separately restored by root.
source_transform_recipe.inverse: ENTIRE raw LANCZOS to original4x; sourceA LANCZOS separately; scalar brightness and original native Type handling by root.

prompt_serialization: Exact actual built-in prompt UTF-8 argument including CRLF equals prompt file bytes; references portable identities resolved against current repo root.
